name: Dnevnik Smotritelja
source:
This story suggests that you look at the camp from a different angle - through the eyes of the overseer.
From the Overseer's Diary, you will learn many fascinating stories that differ from the usual camp shifts.
As the plot develops, the protagonist (Overseer Ren) meets two strong antagonists - you will learn which ones from reading the story.
Ren is not an ordinary person: he has been keeping order in the camps for over 200 years. However, even after such a long time, each shift is important to him because the lives of the pioneers are at stake.
What trials will Ren go through, and will he be able to protect the camp and complete the assigned tasks?
